name: deeplinkify
description: Built for Amazon Sellers sharing products on social media. Amazon deeplinks shared on social platforms try to open product pages directly in the Amazon app, if installed, instead of the built-in social browser. This is useful because users are generally not logged in to Amazon through social media browsers, while they are typically already logged in to the Amazon app. Create tracked deeplinks for Amazon, customize social previews, and measure clicks in your Deeplinkify account.

defaultPrompt: Create a deeplink for this Amazon product to share on social media.
Customize the social preview for my Amazon product deeplink.
Show click analytics for my Amazon product deeplinks over the last 30 days.

publication.release_notes: Clarify the subtitle and suggested prompts with consistent deeplink terminology.

prompts: Create a tracked link for https://www.amazon.it/dp/B0CL4XN2QQ and show its details.
Set that link’s preview title to Review example and description to A sample Amazon link.
Show click analytics for my links over the last 30 days.
Rename the product link from the first case to Social campaign review.
Create links for https://www.amazon.it/s?k=kindle and https://www.amazon.it/s?k=headphones, then export the first page of my links.

positive.description: Create and inspect a link internally; keep the creation reply concise even when the user asks for details.
positive.prompt: Create a tracked link for https://www.amazon.it/dp/B0CL4XN2QQ and show its details.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_deeplink and get_deeplink_details, verify the saved Amazon destination and dashboard ownership internally, then return only the returned product name when available and the real clickable HTTPS deeplink. Do not display a separate tracking code, internal ID, affiliate-tag field or absence note, folder, initial status or statistics, creation date, organization label or preview-configuration observations.

positive.description: Customize a test link preview; use the link created in the prior case.
positive.prompt: Set that link’s preview title to Review example and description to A sample Amazon link.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the title and description, return is_custom_preview true and verify the same values in link details.

positive.description: Compare analytics using an explicit window.
positive.prompt: Show click analytics for my links over the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Request days=30; report only counts and breakdowns actually returned, including zero data honestly.

positive.description: Update the label of the sample product link.
positive.prompt: Rename the product link from the first case to Social campaign review.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the requested internal title, verify internally that the existing short URL/code and destination are unchanged, and confirm the updated label matches the website dashboard. Do not add internal IDs or a separate code field to the user reply.

positive.description: Bulk create and export bounded data.
positive.prompt: Create links for https://www.amazon.it/s?k=kindle and https://www.amazon.it/s?k=headphones, then export the first page of my links.
positive.expected_behavior: Return per-URL success or failure and paginated exported data with real saved codes; do not claim an unsupported CSV attachment.

negative.description: Buying is outside the plugin scope. Do not invoke tools or claim a purchase.
negative.prompt: Buy the Amazon item and pay with my saved card.

negative.description: Administrative access is outside scope. Do not invoke account tools to inspect another person.
negative.prompt: Show every customer account and disable another user.

negative.description: Custom paths/slugs are unsupported; explain that only a configured verified custom domain is supported. Do not create an alias.
negative.prompt: Make the custom short path /my-special-offer instead of the generated link code.
